# Where to Watch Show Me The Father


by Angel | November 19, 2026


What does your relationship with your dad have to do with how you see God? More than you might think. The bond between a father and child can shape a lifetime, influencing everything from personal choices to the way we understand love, trust, and forgiveness.


*Show Me the Father* explores this powerful connection through a collection of true stories from real families. From loving relationships to painful experiences, each story offers a different perspective on fatherhood and reveals how our earthly relationships can shape our understanding of our Heavenly Father.


[Watch Show Me the Father now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/show-me-the-father)


### **Discover the Connection Between Fathers**


One of the documentary’s most meaningful themes is the connection between our earthly fathers and our understanding of God’s love.


For some, a loving relationship with their dad makes it easier to understand the unconditional love of a Heavenly Father. For others, painful experiences can make that connection more difficult. But even when earthly relationships fall short, the documentary points toward a love that never does.


As one Angel Guild member explains, the film makes a powerful connection between fatherhood and the perfect love of our Heavenly Father, reminding viewers that we are adopted as His very own children.


It’s an encouraging reminder that our experiences don’t have to define our relationship with God.


### **Real Stories That Inspire Hope and Healing**


What makes *Show Me the Father* especially moving is its collection of real stories. Rather than relying on a single perspective, the documentary gives real families the opportunity to share their personal experiences with honesty and vulnerability.


Some moments are heartbreaking. Others are surprising, uplifting, and filled with hope. Together, they reveal the power of forgiveness, the importance of family, and the ways love can transform relationships.


Angel Guild members have been especially moved by these stories. One viewer shared, “I had goosebumps through every story,” while another described the film as “honest, hopeful and deeply encouraging.”
